name: zolo-rag
description: Local PDF Chat — drag, drop, and ask questions about your documents.
author: Shanvit Shetty

scripts.builds:mac: node scripts/check-platform.mjs macos && pnpm tauri build --bundles dmg && node scripts/copy-builds.mjs macos
scripts.builds:linux: node scripts/check-platform.mjs linux && pnpm tauri build --bundles deb,appimage && node scripts/copy-builds.mjs linux
scripts.builds:win: node scripts/check-platform.mjs windows && pnpm tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/copy-builds.mjs windows
